newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank does not plan news conference.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank does not plan news conference.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday it does not plan to hold a news conference after its regular fortnightly council meeting.
Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer is chairing the meeting, a spokeswoman said.
Analysts largely expected the central bank would keep its three key lending rates fixed, as there were factors arguing for any adjustment now.
Earlier this morning the Bundesbank said M3 money supply, one of its key policy indicators, grew at an annualised 11.7 percent rate in January compared with the fourth quarter 1996 average rate.
